notes: Michigan requires a work permit for workers under 18. From Oct 2, 2026 permits come through the state Youth Employment Permit Portal.
name: Teen Leadership Program (Growing Hope urban farm)
what_you_do: Work on an urban farm. Learn farming, cooking, food justice and how to organize your community. You lead garden and cooking workshops. Summer is 8 weeks. The after-school program runs September to May.
who_can_apply: High-school-aged youth who live in Ypsilanti and the surrounding townships. For the summer, you must have finished 9th grade and cannot miss more than 4 days. The school-year program is for teens who finished the summer program in good standing.
pay_detail: $14 an hour, plus free weekly produce bags in the growing season.
duration: Summer 2027: June 15 to Aug 6, Monday to Thursday, 9 AM to 2:30 PM. After school: Sept to May, Tue/Wed/Thu, 4 to 6 PM.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open March 1, 2027. A closing date is not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Youth and Schools page when applications open. Questions: Jenny Pritchett, jenny@growinghope.net.
